hypothesis: The intact reference P50 SSM+attention+TTT+depth causal factual-history path trained on observed action outcomes predicts two-action consequences at least 5% better than a comparably sized fully trained GRU and MLP and a degree-two nuisance+action fitted ridge on unfamiliar nonlinear disturbances; a wrong-credit control demonstrates causal use of factual actions.

source.action_schedule: independent fair +/-1 factual executed action in each history step; no fixed alternation
source.training_label: actual completed single query action sensor_next (one factual future for the training query only)
source.evaluator_only: paired -1/+1 query outcomes generated in evaluation cohorts and never exposed in train or model input; physical effect and switch label never fed to model
source.fresh_not_reuse_sources: P47–P50-POL dev cohorts remain consumed; this protocol uses new 811xxx seeds

arms.p50: Original NativeFactualHybridStream.pilot (width=16, all 4 components) with input [8 completed factual events,1 no-outcome query]
arms.matched_gru: GRU hidden=33, common head 16; same event input; ~4521 parameters
arms.matched_mlp: flatten 8*5 factual features + 5 query features, widths 60->30, ~4621 params
arms.wrong_credit_p50: same P50 model and size but historical factual action field cyclically shifted; physical outcomes and actual query labels intact
arms.classical_ridge: degree-two nuisance polynomial in elapsed time + executed factual action, ridge penalty 0.001 on 8 completed history rows, no future outcome
arms.last_factual_effect: latest observed sensor delta divided by executed action, zero-training negative/comparator
arms.parameters_and_active_flops: record exact parameter counts and CPU times; strict equal compute/FLOP matching unverified without full receipt

optimization.validation_competence_gate: relative validation factual MSE decrease from last penultimate to final 40 updates <= 1%; report this as limited proxy, not proof fully converged

additional_metrics: mode-switch vs nonswitch MAE and MSE
per-arm train and inference wall seconds
parameter counts, CPU hardware, torch/python versions
full source SHA256 and sampler indices SHA256
negative_controls: no numerical ground-truth effect in training
source seeds all distinct from previously consumed PRs
